value.rationale: The motivating projected parareal update is a natural way to combine high- and low-resolution stable time propagators. Exact one-step nonexpansivity is needed to guarantee no norm amplification across arbitrary projection choices. The sharp budget 0.828427 and attained constant quantify the additional damping required, and the rational shared-ODE backward-Euler example shows genuine nonnormal transient amplification even when coarse/fine have commuting, strictly contractive and physically meaningful resolvents. This distinguishes spectral decay from Euclidean stability without claiming global method failure.
